bar-padda.name: Bar Padda
bar-padda.era: Tanna/Amora · Land of Israel, early 3rd century
bar-padda.bio: Sage of the Land of Israel at the transition from the Tannaim to the Amoraim, often identified with Bar Kappara.
bar-padda.prompt: A lively, sharp-eyed scholar of the Land of Israel in his 50s with a dark beard touched with grey and a quick, witty expression, wearing a simple woven mantle; background of a sunlit Galilean courtyard with a stone bench and olive trees.
